newsitem.title: USA: USDA offers loan guarantees for new beef co-op.
newsitem.headline: USDA offers loan guarantees for new beef co-op.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Thursday the agency would offer loan guarantees to help ranchers in seven states launch a new beef processing and marketing cooperative.

"A rancher-owned cooperative that would process and market premium beef could provide these hard-pressed ranchers with an opportunity to keep more of the value-added profits generated from the sale of their cattle," Glickman said in a statement.

The Northern Plains Premium Beef Cooperative is seeking ranchers willing to invest at least $2,500 and pledge to deliver cattle to the co-op. Members are sought in the Dakotas, Montana, Minnesota, Wyoming, Iowa and Nebraska.
The cooperative needs to raise about $60 million, half of which will come from member investments.
The announcement is the latest in a series of steps the USDA has taken to combat concentration in the U.S. meat packing industry.
